description.en: The IDs of the excessive device registration applications.

description.zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000。
description.en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10,000.

description.zh: 用户所属部门。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格。
description.en: The user's department. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces.

description.zh:
终端设备ID。取值：
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情。
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备。
description.en:
The device ID. You can get the device ID from the `DeviceTag` parameter returned by the following operations:

- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user's device.

- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries a list of devices for a user.

description.zh: 终端设备名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（\_）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格。单独输入下划线（\_）将额外查询所有名称中带4字节utf-8字符的终端设备。
description.en: The hostname of the device. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. If you specify only an underscore (\_), the query is extended to include devices whose hostnames contain 4-byte UTF-8 characters.
The MAC address of the device.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值范围：1~500。
description.en: The number of entries on each page. Valid values: 1 to 500.

description.zh:
用户ID。取值来源：
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情。
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备。
description.en:
The user ID. You can get the user ID from the `SaseUserId` parameter returned by the following operations:

- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user's device.

- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries a list of devices for a user.

description.zh: 超额注册申请状态集合。
description.en: The statuses of excessive device registration applications.

description.zh: 用户名。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）、星号（*）、at（@）和空格。
description.en: The username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), asterisks (\*), at signs (@), and spaces.

title.zh: 批量查询设备超额注册申请
title.en: Batch query excess registration requests for devices

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas list-excessive-device-registration-applications --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --username '王先生' --sase-user-id su_e8f218fb171edd167c2ad917d21f53148bdefc510ca1f3c3cc0249d3643d0000 --department '测试部' --hostname win10-64bit --mac 00:16:XX:XX:7c:46 --device-tag 36efa42d-2c32-c4dc-e3fc-8541e33a0000 --statuses Pending --application-ids reg-application-0f4a127b7e780000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas ListExcessiveDeviceRegistrationApplications --region cn-hangzhou --Statuses.1 Pending --Department '测试部' --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --Username '王先生' --DeviceTag '36efa42d-2c32-c4dc-e3fc-8541e33a0000' --Hostname 'win10-64bit' --ApplicationIds.1 'reg-application-0f4a127b7e780000' --SaseUserId su_e8f218fb171edd167c2ad917d21f53148bdefc510ca1f3c3cc0249d3643d0000 --Mac '00:16:XX:XX:7c:46' --force
